name: obsidian-llm-wiki
description: Obsidian plugin that scaffolds the LLM Wiki methodology into a vault and drives the pipeline through OpenCode.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/gen-init-wiki.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Yuan Ren
